instruction:
Begin in BRL-CAD with /home/user/Desktop/solid_a.step and /home/user/Desktop/solid_b.step. Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). On this machine, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `solid_a.step`.

The solid_a.step file is the sphere and solid_b.step is the cube. Compute the boolean intersection of the sphere and cube. Create a cylinder with a 12 mm diameter and 10 mm height, oriented along the positive Z-axis. Set its axis to X = 0 mm and Y = 0 mm, its bottom face to Z = 25 mm, and its top face to Z = 35 mm. Union the cylinder with the intersection result. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl.
